_source: DELETE /api/v1/projects/engagement-portal/branches/feat%2Fx/url-prefix when EnsureTenant fails after the claim is released (handlers/projects.go:4408-4412): stale gets "reconciling the branch's route ("+err.Error()+")" (:4435-4439), so msg is the not-reverted sentence (:4443-4447) and data is {branch, routeReverted: len(stale) == 0} (:4448-4451), answered 200. The reconcile error is a STAND-IN
message: URL prefix released, but the live route has NOT reverted yet — reconciling the branch's route (dial tcp 10.0.0.9:6443: i/o timeout) failed. The branch may keep serving on its old host until the next deploy or reconcile.
